text:
maya: Quick kickoff — we're consolidating marketplace deployment patterns + Terraform "plugin" modules for cloud partners.

maya: Kickoff doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace-deploy-patterns (draft) — please review before Wed

sam: Love it. For module naming: do we want `redwood/marketplace/<cloud>/<module>` or `redwood/<module>-marketplace`? Prefer canonical names.

kevin: +1 to namespacing. Also need explicit variants for arm64/graviton and ampere. Plan: release `-x86` and `-arm` providers or use `platform` variable? Thoughts.

ana: Need CI smoke tests: define `make ci-smoke` that runs `terraform init && terraform validate && terraform plan -var 'region=us-west-2'` — should run in partner pipelines. Also add testbed manifest.

maya: Draft checklist snippet:
```
- module: namespaced under redwood/marketplace
- outputs: marketplace_listing.json artifact
- variables: region, instance_type_family, marketplace_metadata
- ci: ci-smoke, e2e-quick
- examples: 1-click deploy + helm values
```

jules-aws: From partner side — marketplace listing wants `product.json` + thumbnail + test deployment instructions. We'll need coordinates for AMIs/ARM/Graviton images.

priya: Can we ship a small "plugin" that injects marketplace metadata (publisher, slugs, tags) into module outputs so partner CI can pick it up? I can prototype.

sam: I can own docs if @maya ok. Will write module README template and usage examples for GCP/AWS/Azure.

cloud_partner_bot: Reminder: marketplace template freeze in 7 days. Submit PRs to `refs/marketplace-templates` branch.

kevin: Also add a note about quantized model runtimes — some partners want GPU vs CPU matrix in examples.

maya: Great. Owners: sam (docs), priya (plugin prototype), kevin (compat matrices), ana (CI smoke), jules-aws (partner listing reqs). Weekly sync Thu 10am PT — calendar invite sent. :rocket:

sam: :thumbsup:

priya: On it, will open prototype PR by EOD tomorrow.

jules-aws: Thanks — will validate AMIs and provide list next week.

maya: Closing — link to doc again: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace-deploy-patterns — please add comments inline.
